note: nothing here was tuned: each antenna is built from the frequency alone, or read from a file

rows.what: 0.47 wavelength wire dipole, 1 mm wire (lambda/120), centre fed, free space
rows.independent_reference: axisymmetric solve of the same wire: resonance 2365 MHz, 72.8 ohm; thin half wave dipole: 73.1 ohm, 2.15 dBi
rows.headline: The dipole resonates at 2303 MHz (-4.0% from 2400 MHz), with 82.8 + j23.6 ohm and S11 of -10.5 dB against 50 ohm at 2400 MHz. Peak gain 2.26 dBi toward theta 90 and phi 80 degrees.

rows.what: 0.24 wavelength monopole on a 1 wavelength round plate
rows.independent_reference: axisymmetric solve with the same 1 wavelength plate: resonance about 2170 MHz (2313 MHz on an infinite plane)
rows.headline: The monopole resonates at 2101 MHz (-12.4% from 2400 MHz), with 62.8 + j37.7 ohm and S11 of -9.5 dB against 50 ohm at 2400 MHz. Peak gain 3.25 dBi toward theta 45 and phi 70 degrees.

rows.what: rectangular patch on 1.6 mm FR4 sized by the transmission line model, probe fed at the inset
rows.independent_reference: transmission line model: 2400 MHz (the solve is 7.5% below it, see docs/limits.md)
rows.headline: The antenna resonates at 2221 MHz (-7.5% from 2400 MHz), with 1.1 + j15.4 ohm and S11 of -0.4 dB against 50 ohm at 2400 MHz. Peak gain 3.11 dBi toward theta 0 and phi 0 degrees.

rows.what: one wavelength circular wire loop, 1 mm wire, fed across a gap
rows.independent_reference: a one wavelength loop has about 3.3 dBi of gain (Kraus)
rows.headline: The antenna resonates at 2641 MHz (+10.0% from 2400 MHz), with 111 - j75 ohm and S11 of -5.3 dB against 50 ohm at 2400 MHz. Peak gain 3.52 dBi toward theta 2 and phi 10 degrees.

rows.what: inverted F trace on 1.6 mm FR4, built from the frequency alone
rows.independent_reference: none of the same shape was available
rows.headline: The antenna resonates at 2130 MHz (-11.3% from 2400 MHz), with 48.2 + j74.4 ohm and S11 of -4.4 dB against 50 ohm at 2400 MHz. Peak gain 2.89 dBi toward theta 100 and phi 340 degrees.

rows.what: inverted F trace read from a KiCad board (examples/antenna-pcb)
rows.independent_reference: none of the same shape was available
rows.headline: The antenna resonates at 2648 MHz (+10.3% from 2400 MHz), with 42.5 - j45 ohm and S11 of -7.1 dB against 50 ohm at 2400 MHz. Peak gain 1.96 dBi toward theta 32 and phi 80 degrees.
